steps.title: A record you wrote yourself
steps.body: 75% hydration, and the loaf collapsed. This note is all that was written. Only the flour differs from the earlier trial

steps.title: A topic the AI built from 8 notes
steps.body: After reading the records the AI raised "crumb structure" and filed the whole-wheat exception to the 75% rule under disagreements. The @ at the end of each line goes back to the record

steps.title: An insight drawn from the claims
steps.body: From trial 7 and the reading notes it pulled out the pattern "enough protein is a precondition". That changes how the next trial is designed

steps.title: A chat, recorded
steps.body: Asked about whole wheat, the AI answers from the trial records and the reading notes. Click a citation to open the source. To ask your own question, connect an AI in Settings

steps.title: Trace how you got here
steps.body: From trial 3 to 7 only the flour changed. Open the graph icon at the top right and pick Genealogy to see trials 1 to 7 lined up along the plan, and this trial's process steps
